_comment: Last-confirmed upstream RF defaults. This file is the EXPECTATION the drift
monitor compares against; firmware/src/ChannelPlan.cpp is the actual table.
tools/rf_drift.py updates this file when upstream moves, and the scheduled
tools/rf_drift.py updates this file when upstream moves, and the scheduled
workflow turns that into a version pull request -- reviewed, not merged blind.
Only record what has been read from a primary source. A value marked
verified: false is carried as 'unconfirmed' and the monitor reports it as
undetermined rather than treating the guess as fact.

meshtastic.what: RDEF() region definitions: band start, band end, duty-cycle limit, power limit

meshcore.what: recommended radio presets per region: '<freq>MHz, SF<n>, BW<bw>, CR<n>'

EU_868.note: RDEF(EU_868, 869.4f, 869.65f, 10, 27, ...). Source comment lists three channels with centres 869.442 / 869.525 / 869.608, so 869.525 is the middle one.

US_915.note: Not read from a primary source. Carried as unconfirmed.

_comment: The FAQ recommends exactly one preset, and says so in prose. The key is
that prose verbatim, so the comparison stays stable while the sentence does
and a rewording shows up as a removal plus an addition rather than silently

USA/Canada (Recommended).note: FAQ: "USA/Canada (Recommended) preset is 910.525MHz, SF7, BW62.5, CR5." Since October 2025 many regions have moved to the narrow plan (BW62.5 and a lower SF). This is NOT the same plan as our US row in ChannelPlan.cpp, which was built from an older SF11 assumption.
